text:
Alex: hey team — day 1 here. trying to spin up a test VM in europe-west1 but getting a zone/region permission error. i created the project under the org, attached the dev billing account, but `gcloud compute instances create` fails with 'permissionDenied: The request was blocked by an organization policy'.
Rachel (cloud-onboarding): welcome! can you paste the exact error and the project id? org policies can block regions at folder level. also check whether the project inherited a 'restrictedLocations' policy.
Alex: error snippet:
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) ResponseError: code=403, message=Access denied. The project 'proj-alex-day1' is not allowed to use region 'europe-west1' by organization policy 'constraints/compute.allowedRegions'
Alex: project id is proj-alex-day1. tagging @Rachel. i'm not sure who manages org folder policies.
Infra Bot: A policy change request workflow exists: https://redwood.internal/governance/policy-requests. To view effective org policies: `gcloud org-policies describe constraints/compute.allowedRegions --organization=ORG_ID --effective`
Samir: hey Alex — i'm on infra. two quick things: 1) confirm the billing account you attached (use `gcloud beta billing projects describe proj-alex-day1`), 2) if billing is ok, it's almost certainly an org-folder policy. send me the folder id or i'll raise a policy exception request.
Alex: billing shows: linkedBillingAccount: 01A2-B3C4-D5E6. folder id is folders/7890123
Rachel (cloud-onboarding): thanks. Samir can you check if folders/7890123 has allowedRegions set? if so we can request addition of europe-west1. Note: adding regions needs org approval for data residency reasons.
Samir: checking now. infra note: we prefer to add by region tag `europe` rather than individual zones. running: `gcloud org-policies describe constraints/compute.allowedRegions --folder=7890123`
Samir: result: allowedRegions = [us-central1, us-east1] — europe-west1 is not allowed. i can open a policy exception but will need an approver (security/compliance) and a brief justification (dev sandbox request).
Alex: can I provide a short justification in the ticket? what's the best format?
Jordan (onboard-eng): Hi Alex — keep it simple: "Sandbox testing for Redwood SDK in eu region; non-prod only; no sensitive data." include project id and timeline (2 weeks). I'll help shepherd the request once Samir opens it.
Samir: opened ticket #POL-2024-881 with justification from Alex + Jordan. pinging @security for approval. ETA 1 business day.
Samir: in the meantime, if you need quick testing, you can run with `--region=us-central1` to avoid policy block; but we'll try to fast-track EU exception.
Alex: thanks all — appreciate the quick help. will hold off on EU runs until we get approval. :thumbsup:
Rachel (cloud-onboarding): note for record: billing linked (01A2-B3C4-D5E6) and policy ticket POL-2024-881. I'll follow up once security approves.
Samir: security approved (manual note): exception granted for proj-alex-day1 for 14 days, region europe-west1 added to folder 7890123 effective now. please test and post any failures.
Alex: tried again — VM created successfully in europe-west1. all good. thanks everyone! :party_popper:
